name: Britannia Tiger Krunch Chocochips
ingredients_raw: NGREDIENTS: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, CHOCO CHIPS (8%) [SUGAR, EDIBLE VEGETABLE FAT, COCOA SOLIDS, DEXTROSE MULSIFIER (322(i))& NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE], INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, COLOURS [150c, 124 & 133], RAISING AGENTS [500(ii) & 503(ii)], COCOA SOLIDS 0.4%), IODISED SALT, EMULSIFIERS [322(i), 471 & 472e], NATURE IDENTICAL (CHOCOLATE) & ARTIFICIAL (VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, MINERAL DOUGH ONDITIONER [223] AND VITAMIN*. (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System) CONTAINS WHEAT, SOY AND SULPHITE.
